suggested_change: Clarify: (1) Carry-forward rule should explicitly define when reinterpretation of prior evidence quality justifies score changes. (2) ICP fit criterion should enumerate disqualifiers, not absence of signals. (3) Criterion 4 should specify whether conditional/exploratory questions violate specificity if they surface new information pathways. (4) Criterion 5 should clarify the boundary between prospect-stated ROI concerns (valid) and seller inferences about value gaps (invalid).
